scope: Exploratory analysis of saved development answers; no new model calls or confirmation outcomes.
question: When two equivalent names trade binding-line locations but retain the same object meaning, does a disagreement follow the queried word or its binding-line location?
design: For each world and field, align the two names across both swaps as a two-by-two table. Use no Focus and unrelated Focus separately; co-referring Focus is excluded because its word also changes under the swap.
name_aligned: Both same-name answers agree across the location swap, but the two names disagree.
line_aligned: Both same-binding-line answers agree across the word swap, but the two line locations disagree.
metric: All tables and per-world counts; paired name-aligned minus line-aligned fraction with 10000 whole-world bootstrap draws, seed20261115.
limits: This identifies a behavioral invariance signature, not an internal causal mechanism. The distinction is known in prior retrieval literature; no novelty claim. Do not count repeated fields as independent worlds.
